_comment: Every buildable asset on the roadmap. Flip `status` to "done" and set `url` when a thing ships. The module pages, unit pages and hub all read this. status: todo | wip | done. Keep slugs identical to roadmap.md.

apps.name: Subnet & VLSM Forge
apps.desc: Generates requirement sets, validates your allocation, explains every failure. Timed mode. Basic mode covers same-subnet determination and mask ↔ CIDR for U3.

apps.name: Packet Journey Simulator
apps.desc: Step a frame and a packet: encapsulation, MAC learning, forward/flood/filter, ARP resolution, routing lookup, watching L2 addresses rewrite at each hop while L3 stays fixed.

apps.name: Binary Blitz
apps.desc: Pure speed: binary ↔ decimal ↔ hex, mask ↔ CIDR, binary ANDing. Leaderboard against the mastery-gate time.

apps.name: Show Command Triage
apps.desc: Symptom in, correct command out. Builds the diagnostic reflex the State Round is built on.

apps.name: Topology Builder Quiz
apps.desc: Requirements in, correct device and cable choice out.

apps.name: Routing Table Decider
apps.desc: Given a routing table and a destination, pick the winning route.

apps.name: DHCP Lease Flow
apps.desc: DORA step-through with the pool, exclusions, gateway and DNS options visible.

apps.name: Acronym Arena
apps.desc: Vocabulary speed drill. Round 1's quiz is Modules 3–7, which is heavily terminology.

apps.name: IPv6 Converter
apps.desc: Compression and expansion plus address-type identification.

apps.name: Port & Protocol Recall
apps.desc: Well-known port numbers and TCP-vs-UDP classification to automaticity.

apps.name: ARP Resolution Walk
apps.desc: Local vs. remote ARP behavior. Watch the cache populate and age.

apps.name: Media Selector
apps.desc: Scenario in, correct media out, with distance, bandwidth and interference constraints.

apps.name: Round Clock Drill
apps.desc: Round simulator: a task list with point values, a clock, and a triage decision each turn.

apps.name: OSI Encapsulation Stepper
apps.desc: Add and strip headers layer by layer; name the PDU at each stage.

labs.name: Orientation
labs.desc: Build and cable a 2-switch, 4-PC topology; identify every device type; save; read an Activity Wizard panel.

labs.name: LAN and Wireless
labs.desc: SOHO wireless router with SSID and WPA2 plus a connected client; wired LAN alongside; watch the MAC table populate; step one PDU in Simulation mode.

labs.name: Addressing and DHCP
labs.desc: Address two LANs by hand in IPv4 and IPv6, then convert one to router-based DHCP and verify leases.

labs.name: Forwarding Forensics
labs.desc: Simulation-mode hop-by-hop trace across a two-router path; record source and destination MAC and IP at every hop.

labs.name: Routing and ARP
labs.desc: The reference topology: static and default routes, ARP cache inspection, one planted fault.

labs.name: Services and Troubleshooting
labs.desc: DNS and HTTP server, two planted faults of different types, diagnosed with the 8-step sequence and narrated.

labs.name: Subnet Design
labs.desc: VLSM a /24 across four host requirements, then address and verify a live topology from the written plan.

labs.name: Capstone B
labs.desc: Full mock round, topology B, for the second consecutive-run gate.

quizzes.name: U1 Boot Camp Check
quizzes.desc: Intro plus Modules 1–2. Mirrors the Practice Round quiz scope exactly.

quizzes.name: U2 Ethernet Check
quizzes.desc: Modules 3–7. Mirrors the Round 1 quiz scope exactly.

quizzes.name: Veteran Challenge-Out Pretest
quizzes.desc: U1–U3 challenge-out. Pass and you join at U4.

sheets.name: Devices, Cables & Link Lights
sheets.desc: Device types, interface naming, cable selection, link-light meanings.

sheets.name: OSI, TCP/IP & Encapsulation
sheets.desc: OSI ↔ TCP/IP map, PDU per layer, encapsulation order.

sheets.name: Round Playbook
sheets.desc: Round clock strategy and the fixed configuration order.

sheets.name: Wireless & SOHO
sheets.desc: SSID, WPA2/WPA3, channel, DHCP scope, admin defaults.

sheets.name: Subnet Table
sheets.desc: Mask ↔ CIDR ↔ magic number ↔ host count.

sheets.name: IPv4 Ranges
sheets.desc: Private/public, loopback, APIPA, multicast; unicast vs. broadcast.

sheets.name: IPv6 Quick Reference
sheets.desc: Compression rules, address types, prefix recognition.

sheets.name: DHCP & DORA
sheets.desc: DORA sequence and router DHCP-pool syntax.

sheets.name: Forwarding Map
sheets.desc: Switch decision tree plus what changes at each routed hop.

sheets.name: Routing
sheets.desc: Static/default route syntax, show ip route field map, ARP behavior.

sheets.name: Ports & Protocols
sheets.desc: Well-known ports, TCP vs. UDP, application services.

sheets.name: Diagnostic Sequence
sheets.desc: The 8-step troubleshooting order and what each step proves.

sheets.name: Binary & Hex
sheets.desc: Conversion tables and a binary ANDing worked example.
